info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Card Clearing Review-spec
info.description: The Card Clearing Reviews Submission API enables businesses to submit reviews related to card clearing transactions. This operation is essential for financial institutions or payment processors looking to provide feedback or analysis on transaction processes. Users can submit reviews for specific card clearing transactions identified by a unique parameter. Typical consumers include payment processing teams and compliance departments, ensuring transparency and accountability in financial operations.

post.summary: Submit a review for a card clearing transaction.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the specified card clearing transaction identified by CARD-400045. It captures user feedback and helps improve the transaction process. Ensure all required information is provided in the request body.
